description: South Korea family business inheritance deduction (가업상속공제, 상증법 제18조의2) and inheritance tax with vs without it: cap 30B/40B/60B KRW for 10/20/30+ years of operation, qualifying value = share value × (1 − non-business asset ratio), plus lump-sum 500M, spouse and financial asset deductions and the 3% filing credit. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Does not judge eligibility requirements or post-management; the 2026-08 reform proposal is not applied.

businessValue.description: Value of the family business shares (or sole-proprietor business assets), KRW

netFinancial.description: Net financial assets among the other property, KRW

otherEstate.description: Other inherited property outside the business, KRW

size.description: sme, midsize (3-year average revenue under 500B KRW) or ineligible

spouseInherited.description: Amount the spouse actually inherits, KRW

unrelatedAssetRatio.description: Non-business assets ÷ total assets of the company, 0-1 (0 for a sole proprietorship)

years.description: Years the deceased operated the business

name: calculate_kr_family_business_deduction
title: calculate kr family business deduction
